name: Greater Milestone: Bloodsworn
entriesHtml:
When you achieve this level of milestone, you gain the following benefit.

Tenacity.

You can resist effects that would slow your oath from being carried out. If you begin your turn with the Frightened, Incapacitated, Paralyzed, or Stunned condition, you may choose to end one of those conditions. Once you use this, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest|XPHB.

name: Greater Milestone: Cursemarked
entriesHtml:
When you achieve this level of milestone, you lose all prior milestone benefits from this thread and gain the following benefits.

Threads Entwined [1–7, Saving Throws, Ability Checks, Attack Rolls].

You can't take Bonus Action|XPHB|Bonus Actions or Reaction|XPHB|Reactions until the end of your next turn. When this occurs, another creature of your choice within 30 feet of you can immediately use its Reaction|XPHB to take the Dash, Help, or Hide action, or make a single weapon attack against a target in range.

Greater Sacrifice.

When your Threads Entwined is triggered, you can instead choose to do nothing this turn besides move. If you've already taken your action this turn, you instead forgo your action on your next turn. If you do so, the chosen creature can take one additional action on its next turn, except the Magic action, or it can receive the benefit of one of the previous milestone's Greater Sacrifices. Once you use your Greater Sacrifice, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest|XPHB.

name: Greater Milestone: Explorer
entriesHtml:
When you achieve this level of milestone, you gain one of the following benefits.

Ennobled.

A monarch has recognized your achievements as an Explorer in their or other territories by granting you a noble title, which comes with a moderately sized estate. You have Advantage|XPHB on Charisma checks with anyone who would be impressed or intimidated by your title. You also can avoid punishment for minor infractions, though if you abuse this, your title might be revoked.

Wayfarer's Steps.

You can never become lost by nonmagical means and can always retrace your steps. Additionally, as a Bonus Action|XPHB, you can take the Dash action and command up to 4 willing creatures who can hear you to use their Reaction|XPHB to immediately take a Dash action. Neither you nor your allies trigger Opportunity Attack while moving in this way. Once you use this Bonus Action|XPHB, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest|XPHB.

name: Superior Milestone: Fatebound

Last Act of Fate.

At a moment you have predetermined to be the time when you are to die, when you are reduced to 0 Hit Points|XPHB or killed outright, you may (no action required) instead set your Hit Points|XPHB to 1. You lose any detrimental conditions, and any harmful effects on you are ended immediately. Until the end of your next turn, you gain Advantage|XPHB on all attack rolls and ability checks, you have Immunity|XPHB to all damage and conditions (and other effects at the GM's discretion), and you add your character level to all damage rolls.

At the end of your next turn, you die and can never be restored to life.

Glorious End.

If you achieve your destiny in a way that earns you a seat in Valhalla (or some other appropriate afterlife), the allies who witness your death have Advantage|XPHB on all D20 Test|XPHB|d20 rolls for 24 hours as they are inspired by your heroism.

Heroic Saga.

Your tales grow so powerful that they can briefly tamper with luck. After you spend at least 10 minutes telling an inspiring story or legend, choose either one creature who can hear you, or up to three creatures. You can't select yourself as a target. Once you use this, you can't use it again until for 7 days.

Luck Boon (Three Targets).

name: Superior Milestone: Legend Hunter
entriesHtml:
When you achieve this level of milestone, you gain the following benefit.

Legend Breaker.

When you hit a creature that has Legendary Resistance or Legendary Actions, you can choose to forgo dealing damage to force that creature to make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 plus your Strength or Wisdom modifier and your Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, the target becomes unable use its Legendary Resistance or its Legendary Actions. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Once you use this, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest|XPHB.

The Ultimate Favor.

You performed a service for a powerful healer, who was caught in an animal trap set by another hunter. In return, they have offered to cast a single spell of healing of 6th to 9th level on you or a creature of your choice, at a time of your choosing, even if this puts them at great risk. This should be a spell that heals, regenerates, resurrects, or that removes conditions or curses.
